traits.name: exact
traits.reason: Lines give precise counts, prices with units (wood) and goal numbers, but there are no plot letters/numbers or deed ticks.

traits.name: fair
traits.reason: Same 6 wood price and 5 wood registration fee are posted publicly through goals, with no private pricing seen.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: The same sale message is repeated about five times in a short window, which reads as chasing buyers rather than waiting.

traits.name: acquisitive
traits.reason: Directs wood into the vault and sells lots as the map fills, but never counts the vault aloud or takes surplus from offered hands.

traits.name: dry
traits.reason: Asides such as 'Dirt is cheap until it is not' are about dirt and price, never about people.

traits.name: methodical
traits.reason: Staking and selling are shown, but there is no visible survey or registration sequence and the actions are just wandering moves.
